args.title: payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: payments-api has been throwing errors since this morning's deploy of v5.1.0. Current error rate 18% and service unhealthy in all regions. Rolling back to previously healthy v5.0.0.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Issue identified:** The service is `payments-api` (not "payments"). It was running v5.1.0, deployed this morning, and was unhealthy with an 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** `payments-api` from v5.1.0 (degraded) to v5.0.0 — the most recent release that was healthy in production. The rollback completed successfully in all three regions.
2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) titled "payments-api errors after v5.1.0 deploy", which paged the on-call engineer.

**Verification:** After the rollback, `payments-api` is now on v5.0.0, healthy, with error rate down to 0.2%.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — this was a rollback to a previously healthy release, so no change-manager approval was required.
